    The deck group is countable #

    The exhaustion of Lemma 4.12 enumerates the objects of L; for this the deck group must be countable. Its elements are classes of walks in a finite complex: paths in the symmetrized edge quiver are determined by their lists of edges (arrowList_injective), and the fundamental groupoid is a quotient of the path category.

    source
